gallery.description: John Trumbull's painting, Declaration of Independence, depicting the five-man drafting committee of the Declaration of Independence presenting their work to the Congress. The painting can be found on the back of the U.S. $2 bill. The original hangs in the US Capitol rotunda. It does not represent a real ceremony; the characters portrayed were never in the same room at the same time.

gallery.title: File:Capitol Building (50233232923).jpg
gallery.description:
Picture of the Capitol building... around Christmas in 2012 or 2013.  The roll of film had been sitting in a Nikkormat FTN for around 10 years.
Kodak BW400CN film (C-41 process), developed with Rollei Colorchem C-41 Kit.  Kodak stopped making BW400CN in 2014. Finally decided to try C-41 processing at home, figured I could practice with an old roll, didn't really expect images to come out at all given the age of the film.

Nikkormat FTN, Kodak BW400CN, Rollei Colorchem C-41 kit
